about: Where a library version of a module sits in a layout (docs/shared-modules.md; web packages/modules placement.ts, desktop src/edit/SharedModulePlacement.cpp). A placement {degrees, x, y} turns the version's own coordinates by `degrees` about its origin, then moves them to (x, y); each part turns about its pivot (its sprite centre: the box centre plus the footprint's image offset, which is non-zero only for a part with a hull) and its box is its footprint at the new angle (a part no catalog knows keeps its box size). `parts`: the geometry of each part number (lower case; `mystery.1` is in no catalog). `place`: a version's parts, a placement, and the parts as placed. `move`, `turn`, `drop`: the placement after the placed module is moved, turned about a point, or dropped (moved by dx, dy, then turned by a connection snap about `pivot` onto `to`). `align`: the placement worked out from the parts, and how many agree. `matches`: whether the placed parts are exactly the version's. `resolve`: the placement to use, the one kept while at least half the parts are where it puts them, else the one worked out. Numbers agree within `tolerance`; angles also across 0/360.

align.name: where it was placed, a quarter turn
one part moved and one swapped: the rest still say where
nothing alike: middle on middle, unturned

matches.name: as placed, the placement not known
moved as a whole since the placement was written
a part moved by less than a hair

resolve.name: kept, one part changed: still the kept one
an older app moved the module: worked out, sheets kept
no parts left: the kept one
